pages.title: The Basics
pages.text: Foods that originate from a given biome will provide you with a status effect. This does not change when the food already provides a status effect.

pages.title: Taigas
pages.text: Foods originating from the Taiga biome will provide you with Invisibility for 2 minutes.

pages.title: Jungles
pages.text: Foods originating from Jungle biomes (Sparse Jungle, Bamboo Jungle, etc.) biome will provide you with Haste II for 2 minutes.

pages.title: Flower Biomes
pages.text: Foods originating from the Flower Forest or Sunflower Plains biome will provide you with Regeneration II for 2 minutes.

pages.title: Birch Forests
pages.text: Foods originating from the Birch Forest or Old Growth Birch Forest biome will provide you with Speed II for 2 minutes.
